
ADD-STEP
Add a step to a scenario in a feature file

USAGE
  fspec add-step <file> <scenario> <type> <text>

ARGUMENTS
  <file> (required)
    Feature file path
  <scenario> (required)
    Scenario name
  <type> (required)
    Step type: given, when, then, and, or but
  <text> (required)
    Step text (e.g., "I am logged in")

OPTIONS
  No options available

EXAMPLES
  1. Add given step
  $ fspec add-step spec/features/login.feature "Login with valid credentials" given "I am on the login page"
  ✓ Added step to scenario

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec add-scenario
  fspec update-step
  fspec delete-step
